review_scope: Exact-hash incremental successor to the v0.5 physical-site review, adding eight construction projects through eight closed portable geometry bridges: one official project locator, six scoped campus locators, and one official campus boundary. No inherited acceptance or frozen release is modified.

acceptances.precision_scope: Official source-reported point used only to locate the PNQ04 project. It is not a project centroid, footprint, parcel, building outline, construction extent, campus boundary, or survey-accuracy claim.
acceptances.decision_basis: The same official compliance report names Development of Data Center PNQ04, gives BG 80/B in Bhosari, and prints the coordinate normalized by the bridge; the v97 project is the PNQ04 current build at BG 80/B.

acceptances.precision_scope: Contributor-mapped polygon for STT Jakarta 1, used only as one known-building anchor for the shared campus targeted by STT Jakarta 3. It is not the Jakarta 3 location or footprint, the campus boundary, a parcel, a construction extent, or a survey-accuracy claim.
acceptances.decision_basis: The v97 STT Jakarta 3 project explicitly targets the shared STT Jakarta campus in v14. STT's expansion disclosure groups Jakarta 3, 5, and 6 under that singular campus; its Jakarta 1 factsheet places Jakarta 1 within the campus; and the frozen OSM polygon is exactly named STT Jakarta 1 and tagged ref Jakarta 1.

acceptances.precision_scope: Official address representative point used only to locate the OSL1 campus inherited by Phase 2. It is not the Phase 2 location or footprint, a building centroid, parcel, campus boundary, construction extent, or survey-accuracy claim.
acceptances.decision_basis: The v97 Phase 2 project explicitly targets OSL1 in v14; Skygard labels OSL1 at Hovinbyen; NVE case 19357 identifies the data center at Østre Aker vei 24C and names SKYGARD 1 AS; and Kartverket returns exactly one verified official-address record for Østre Aker vei 24C, 0581 Oslo.

acceptances.precision_scope: Official address/building reference point used only to locate the HKG09 campus inherited by the current redevelopment. It is not a parcel, building footprint or centroid, redevelopment extent, construction extent, campus boundary, or survey-accuracy claim.
acceptances.decision_basis: The v97 redevelopment explicitly targets HKG09. Goodman's current pipeline gives HKG09 the exact address 57-61 Ta Chuen Ping St; the Lands Department Location Search returns that house-number range as its first result; and the official transformation API converts that result's HK80 coordinates to the WGS84 point used by the bridge.

acceptances.precision_scope: Exact current Kartverket cadastral polygon for parcel 10/760, used only to locate the Nscale Kvandal campus and inherited by the 25 MW current-build project through the explicit v14 project_targets relationship. The parcel contains both officially mapped data-center buildings and is not the footprint or centroid of Data Center 1, the 25 MW EPC project, Data Center 2, or the complete campus.
acceptances.decision_basis: The v97 25 MW project explicitly targets the Nscale Kvandal campus in v14. The NVE government case maps 25 MW Data Center 1 and 75 MW Data Center 2 at the Kvandal/Skoglund site; its official map center falls inside the exact current Kartverket parcel 10/760, and both mapped buildings occupy that parcel container.

acceptances.precision_scope: Exact deterministic union of three Kartverket official cadastral parcel polygons explicitly listed as the Green Mountain project address in the approved municipal situation plan and area schedule. It is not a survey-accuracy claim, security fence, building outline, current construction extent, or assertion that every square metre is developed.
acceptances.decision_basis: The v97 project explicitly targets the Undheim campus. Time municipality permit 2025/1487 names VUU1 AS as applicant; approved drawings in that same case name Green Mountain AS as project owner and list parcels 46/316, 46/317 and 46/319; the published rounded parcel areas match the Kartverket union; and Backe identifies Green Mountain as client for the current Undheim works.
